previous.zh: 嘗對群臣稱太子似宣帝，於是令譽流於天下。
previous.literal: He once declared before the assembled ministers that the crown prince resembled Emperor Xuan; thereafter praise of him spread through the realm.
previous.idiomatic: He once told the assembled ministers that the crown prince resembled Emperor Xuan; the prince's good reputation spread throughout the realm.

unit.zh: 時望氣者言廣陵有天子氣，故封為廣陵王，邑五萬戶。
unit.literal: At the time, observers of celestial portents said Guangling had the aura of a Son of Heaven; therefore he was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling with a fief of fifty thousand households.
unit.idiomatic: At the time observers of portents said Guangling had the aura of a Son of Heaven, so he was enfeoffed Prince of Guangling, with a fief of fifty thousand households.

next.zh: 以劉寔為師，孟珩為友，楊准、馮蓀為文學。
next.literal: Liu Shi was made tutor, Meng Heng companion, and Yang Zhun and Feng Sun literary aides.
next.idiomatic: Liu Shi served as tutor, Meng Heng as companion, and Yang Zhun and Feng Sun as literary aides.

previous.zh: 既至，後不見，置於別室，遣婢陳舞賜以酒棗，逼飲醉之。
previous.literal: When he arrived she did not receive him but lodged him in a side chamber, sent maid Chen Wu with ale and jujubes, and forced him drunk.
previous.idiomatic: When he arrived, the empress did not see him but put him in a separate room. She sent the maid Chen Wu with wine and jujubes and pressed him to drink until he was drunk.

unit.zh: 使黃門侍郎潘岳作書草，若禱神之文，有如太子素意，因醉而書之，令小婢承福以紙筆及書草使太子書之。
unit.literal: She had Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Pan Yue draft a prayer text mimicking the crown prince's usual intent; because he was drunk she made him copy it, giving small maid Chengfu paper, brush, and draft.
unit.idiomatic: She had Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Pan Yue draft a prayer text mimicking the Crown Prince's usual intent; because he was drunk she made him copy it, having the young maid Chengfu bring paper, brush, and draft.

next.zh: 文曰：「陛下宜自了；
next.literal: The text read: 'Your Majesty should settle matters himself.
next.idiomatic: Forgery opened: 'Father must finish this himself.

previous.zh: 後懼事變，乃表免太子為庶人，詔許之。
previous.literal: The empress feared events might shift and therefore memorialized to degrade the crown prince to commoner status; an edict approved.
previous.idiomatic: Fearing that events might change, the empress submitted a memorial asking that the crown prince be reduced to commoner status; the emperor approved by edict.

unit.zh: 於是使尚書和郁持節，解結為副，及大將軍梁王肜、鎮東將軍淮南王允、前將軍東武公澹、趙王倫、太保何劭詣東宮，廢太子為庶人。
unit.literal: Thereupon Minister Director He Yu was dispatched with insignia, Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Rong, Prince of Liang, Eastern Garrison General Yun, Prince of Huainan, Forward General Eastern Martial Duke Dan, Lun, Prince of Zhao, and Grand Guardian He Shao to the Eastern Palace to depose the crown prince as commoner.
unit.idiomatic: Thereupon Minister Director He Yu was dispatched with insignia, with Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Sima Rong, Prince of Liang; Eastern Garrison General Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan; Forward General Sima Dan, Eastern Martial Duke; Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao; and Grand Guardian He Shao. They went to the Eastern Palace to depose the Crown Prince as a commoner.

next.zh: 是日太子游玄圃，聞有使者至，改服出崇賢門，再拜受詔，步出承華門，乘粗犢車。
next.literal: That day the crown prince roamed the Mystic Garden; hearing envoys arrived he changed clothes, exited Chongxian Gate, twice bowed receiving the edict, walked out Chenghua Gate, and rode a rough ox-cart.
next.idiomatic: Yu took the edict from the garden and rode an ox-cart out.

previous.zh: 太子既廢非其罪，眾情憤怨。
previous.literal: After the crown prince was deposed without crime, popular feeling seethed with anger.
previous.idiomatic: The crown prince had been deposed for no fault of his own, and people were indignant.

unit.zh: 右衛督司馬雅，宗室之疏屬也，與常從督許超並有寵于太子，二人深傷之，說趙王倫謀臣孫秀曰：「國無適嗣，社稷將危，大臣之禍必起。
unit.literal: Sima Ya, a commandant of the Right Guard and a distant member of the imperial clan, and Xu Chao, a commandant of the regular attendants, both enjoyed the crown prince's favor. Deeply grieved, they spoke to Sun Xiu, an adviser to Lun, Prince of Zhao: 'The state has no rightful heir, the altars of soil and grain will be endangered, and disaster will surely arise for the great ministers.
unit.idiomatic: Sima Ya, a Right Guard commandant and distant member of the imperial clan, and Xu Chao, a commandant of the regular attendants, were both favored by the crown prince. Deeply grieved, they told Sun Xiu, an adviser to Lun, Prince of Zhao: "The state has no rightful heir; the dynasty is in danger, and disaster will surely come upon the great ministers.

next.zh: 而公奉事中宮，與賈后親密，太子之廢，皆云豫知，一旦事起，禍必及矣。
next.literal: You serve the inner palace and are close to Empress Jia; everyone says you knew of the crown prince's deposition beforehand. If trouble breaks out, disaster will surely reach you.
next.idiomatic: You serve the inner palace and are close to Empress Jia; everyone says you knew of the crown prince's deposition beforehand. If trouble breaks out, disaster will surely reach you.

unit.zh: 秀言于趙王倫，倫深納焉。
unit.literal: Xiu told Lun, Prince of Zhao, who readily accepted the proposal.
unit.idiomatic: Sun Xiu told Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, who readily accepted the proposal.

next.zh: 計既定，而秀說倫曰：「太子為人剛猛，若得志之日，必肆其情性矣。
next.literal: With the plan set, Xiu said to Lun, 'The crown prince is by nature rigid and fierce; if he gains his will he will certainly give free rein to his temper.
next.idiomatic: With the plan set, Xiu said to Lun, "The crown prince is by nature rigid and fierce; if he gains his will he will certainly give free rein to his temper.

originalUnit.zh: 秀言于趙王倫，倫深納焉。
originalUnit.literal: Xiu reported to Prince Zhao of Lun, and Lun accepted fully.
originalUnit.idiomatic: Sun Xiu sold the plot to Sima Lun.

previous.zh: 芒芒羽蓋，翼翼縉紳。
previous.literal: Vast feather-canopies; crowded sash-and-hat ranks.
previous.idiomatic: A vast array of feathered canopies; rank upon rank of officials.

unit.zh: 同悲等痛，孰不酸辛！
unit.literal: Shared grief and equal pain—who lacks bitter sorrow!
unit.idiomatic: All share the same grief and pain: who does not feel bitter sorrow?

next.zh: 庶光來葉，永世不泯。」
next.literal: May light reach posterity, never extinguished through ages.'
next.idiomatic: May light reach posterity, never extinguished through ages."

originalUnit.zh: 同悲等痛，孰不酸辛！
originalUnit.literal: Shared grief and equal pain—who lacks bitter sorrow!
originalUnit.idiomatic: Courtiers weep together.

previous.zh: 諡曰湣懷。
previous.literal: Posthumous title Minhuai was granted.
previous.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous name Minhuai.

unit.zh: 六月己卯，葬于顯平陵。
unit.literal: On jimao day of the sixth month he was buried at Xianping Mausoleum.
unit.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the sixth month, he was buried at Xianping Mausoleum.

next.zh: 帝感閻纘之言，立思子台，故臣江統、陸機並作誄頌焉。
next.literal: Moved by Yan Zuan's words the emperor raised a Terrace of Longing for Sons; former ministers Jiang Tong and Lu Ji both composed dirges.
next.idiomatic: Yan Zuan's plea built Son-Lament Terrace—Jiang Tong and Lu Ji wrote elegies.

originalUnit.zh: 六月己卯，葬于顯平陵。
originalUnit.literal: On jimao day of the sixth month he was buried at Xianping Mausoleum.
originalUnit.idiomatic: Buried sixth month at Xianping.

previous.zh: 字道文，永康元年正月，薨。
previous.literal: Bin, courtesy name Daowen, died in the first month of Yongkang year one.
previous.idiomatic: Eldest Bin (Daowen) died Yongkang first month.

unit.zh: 四月，追封南陽王。
unit.literal: In the fourth month posthumous investiture as Prince of Nanyang.
unit.idiomatic: Fourth month titled Prince of Nanyang.

next.zh: 臧字敬文。

next.zh: 己巳，詔曰：「咎征數發，奸回作變，遹既逼廢，非命而沒。
next.literal: On jisi day an edict stated: 'Ill omens pile; crafty factions stir; Yu was driven from office and died unnaturally.

originalUnit.idiomatic: Yongkang fourth month made Linhuai prince.

previous.literal: Emperor Wu cherished him and deeply laid succession plans.
previous.idiomatic: Wu Di planned Yu as future pillar.

unit.zh: 天下歸心，頗有後來之望。
unit.literal: All under Heaven turned hearts toward him—high hopes attended his future.
unit.idiomatic: All under Heaven turned their hearts toward him and had considerable hopes for his future.

next.zh: 及於繼明宸極，守器春坊，四教不勤，三朝或闕，豹姿未變，鳳德已衰，信惑奸邪，疏斥正士，好屠酤之賤役，耽苑囿之佚遊，可謂靡不有初，鮮克有終者也。
next.literal: Yet once succeeding to the bright apex, guarding vessels in the spring quarters, he neglected the four teachings and skipped three audiences—leopard bearing unchanged yet phoenix virtue decayed; he trusted wicked deceit and spurned upright gentlemen, fond of butcher-shop drudgery and addicted to park amusement—one may say rarely does glory stay finished.
next.idiomatic: Editors blame Yu for vice after enthronement as heir.

unit.zh: 贊曰：湣懷聰穎，諒惟天挺。
unit.literal: The encomium says: Minhuai clever and keen—truly Heaven-endowed.
unit.idiomatic: The encomium says: Minhuai was intelligent and perceptive, truly endowed by Heaven.

next.zh: 皇祖鐘心，庶僚引領。
next.literal: Imperial ancestor pinned hope on him; hosts of officials craned necks.
next.idiomatic: His imperial grandfather treasured him; the assembled officials craned their necks in expectation.

previous.literal: 'Gathering wasps' schemes split cracks—sacrificial meat bred calamity.
previous.idiomatic: Wasp-and-meat allusions to court intrigue.

unit.zh: 既罹凶忍，徒望歸來。
unit.literal: Once brutal cruelty struck, vain hope alone remained of return.
unit.idiomatic: Once he fell victim to ruthless cruelty, hope for his return was in vain.

originalUnit.zh: 既罹凶忍，徒望歸來。

originalUnit.idiomatic: Death ended every hope of restoration.

previous.zh: 每見喜怒之際，輒歎曰：「殿下不知用威刑，天下豈得畏服！」
previous.literal: Whenever she saw him angry or pleased she would sigh, 'Your Highness does not know how to wield awe and punishment—how will the realm ever fear and obey!'

unit.zh: 太子所幸蔣美人生男，又言宜隆其賞賜，多為皇孫造玩弄之器，太子從之。
unit.literal: When Lady Jiang, whom the crown prince favored, bore a son, they also said rewards should be lavish and many toys fashioned for the imperial grandson; the crown prince obeyed.
unit.idiomatic: When the crown prince's favored Lady Jiang bore a son, they also urged lavish rewards and the making of many toys for the imperial grandson. The crown prince followed their advice.

next.zh: 於是慢弛益彰，或廢朝侍，恆在後園遊戲。

next.idiomatic: His arrogance and laxity became increasingly evident; he sometimes neglected court attendance and was constantly playing in the rear garden.

unit.literal: Thereupon Minister Director He Yu was dispatched with insignia, Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Rong, Prince of Liang, Eastern Garrison General Yun, Prince of Huainan, Forward General Eastern Martial Duke Dan, Lun, Prince of Zhao, and Grand Guardian He Shao to the Eastern Palace to depose the crown prince as commoner.

They went to the Eastern Palace to depose the Crown Prince as a commoner.

next.zh: 是日太子游玄圃，聞有使者至，改服出崇賢門，再拜受詔，步出承華門，乘粗犢車。

next.idiomatic: Yu took the edict from the garden and rode an ox-cart out.
